argv:
An organization has ended up with no owner at all: the last one was removed from the members list and nobody can reach billing or the danger-zone settings any more. Demoting that same person to a lesser role is still correctly refused — it is only removal that lets it happen. Find the cause and fix it.

This is a `fix` task: edit the code and stop. Do not write a summary and do not emit an ANSWER line.
